title: Connect your Amazon Seller Central account
intro: Direct, automatic sync with Seller Central isn't live yet.
introBody: For now, upload your Amazon VAT Transactions Report manually from VAT reports — everything else in FiscorAI already works from that file. Automatic syncing is next.
comingItem1: Automatic report import via Amazon's Selling Partner API — no more manual CSV exports.
comingItem2: Inventory location tracking, so nexus flags update the moment your stock moves.
comingItem3: One-click reconnect if your authorization ever expires.
notify: Want to know the moment this ships?
